live_checks.evidence: Map probe, sanitized geometry metadata, and PDA comparison

live_validation_required.what: Actual FieldManager polygon and field-to-farmland extraction
live_validation_required.procedure: Load the target save, run sinSelfTest, and retain the map probe and startup map_geometry evidence.
live_validation_required.success: Expected field IDs, world polygon points, dimensions, and field.farmland.id are present and valid.
live_validation_required.failure: Adapt the runtime exporter to the target FS25 build or leave the map unavailable.

live_validation_required.what: FarmlandManager IDs, density-map relationship, and snapshot ownership
live_validation_required.procedure: Compare probe IDs and authenticated snapshot ownership with the in-game farmland layer; request a parcel overlay only where trusted polygon geometry exists.
live_validation_required.success: IDs/ownership agree and no field polygon is presented as a farmland boundary.
live_validation_required.failure: Treat parcel geometry or ownership as unavailable/stale; do not claim a successful overlay.

live_validation_required.procedure: Render Field 22 and an irregular field, then compare the attachment with the in-game PDA at corners and interior landmarks.
live_validation_required.success: Highlights align in position and orientation.
live_validation_required.failure: Adjust explicit orientation metadata or retain geometry-only output pending verification.

live_validation_required.what: Runtime map/save change detection and refresh
live_validation_required.procedure: In a disposable test context, load a different map/save, emit a new runtime generation, and verify central reload/revision behavior.
live_validation_required.success: The new server/save projection is selected, delayed older data is rejected, and prior geometry does not leak across contexts.
live_validation_required.failure: Improve runtime generation or map identity detection before relying on automatic refresh.

live_validation_required.what: Real Discord attachment delivery and visual readability
live_validation_required.procedure: Publish a contract/farmland card through the configured Jobs channel using the generic release artifact.
live_validation_required.success: The PNG is attached/readable and the requested selection is visible; text fallback remains usable when rendering is unavailable.
live_validation_required.failure: Investigate Discord permissions, raster scaling, or alignment without weakening durable workflow state.

live_validation_required.what: FS25/Agent restart and interrupted geometry event behavior
live_validation_required.procedure: Restart the dedicated server and Agent around one geometry export and retry one interrupted/malformed mailbox event.
live_validation_required.success: The valid event is delivered once, malformed data is quarantined, and no proprietary map path/asset is copied.
live_validation_required.failure: Fix mailbox timing or runtime lifecycle handling before production use.
